html:
You are ready

No amount of time will make you any better nor any other time will be more opportune than now.

If your intention is pure which you can announce the world

If you are truthful to yourself

If you have courage to fight till the end to achieve your goal

Then…

Today is the day, now is the time and entire universe will support you to achieve the goal.

Carry good portion of patience, perseverance, and enthusiasm in your lunchbox for your journey ahead as you may need it on the way.
